metadata.question: Were there fewer fire detections in Brazil in 2019 than in 2007?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use MODIS Active Fire detections (MCD64A1 for burned area or MODIS thermal anomalies) or FIRMS data. I'll use the MODIS Thermal Anomalies & Fire Radiative Power (MOD14A1) dataset, which contains fire detection data. Alternatively, I can use the GEDI or FIRMS dataset. I'll use MOD14A1 which gives fire detections globally. The collection is 'MODIS/006/MOD14A1'. Need to compare 2007 vs 2019 over Brazil. 2. Masking strategy: Fire detections are the data themselves, so no cloud masking needed. I need to count fire pixels (confidence > 0) in each year. 3. Logic: Count fire detections (pixels with fire confidence > 0) in Brazil for both years. If 2019 < 2007, answer is A (Yes, fewer). If 2019 >= 2007, answer is B (No, not fewer). If no data in either year, C1. If all pixels masked out, C2. If calculation fails, C3. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Brazil geometry const brazil = ee.FeatureCollection('USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017').filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_na', 'Brazil')); // 2. Define date ranges const start2007 = '2007-01-01'; const end2007 = '2007-12-31'; const start2019 = '2019-01-01'; const end2019 = '2019-12-31'; // 3. Load MODIS Thermal Anomalies (fire detection dataset) const mod14a1 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD14A1'); // Filter for 2007 const fires2007 = mod14a1 .filterDate(start2007, end2007) .filterBounds(brazil); // Filter for 2019 const fires2019 = mod14a1 .filterDate(start2019, end2019) .filterBounds(brazil); print('Data Collection Check:'); print('2007 Images: ' + fires2007.size().getInfo()); print('2019 Images: ' + fires2019.size().getInfo()); // Check for empty collections if (fires2007.size().getInfo() === 0) { print('No data for 2007.'); print('C1'); return; } if (fires2019.size().getInfo() === 0) { print('No data for 2019.'); print('C1'); return; } // 4. Count fire detections (FireMask band, values > 0 indicate fire) // Use the 'FireMask' band: 0=no fire, 1-8=fire with different confidence levels const countFires2007 = fires2007 .select('FireMask') .map(function(img) { return img.gt(0).rename('fire_count'); }) .reduce(ee.Reducer.sum()); const countFires2019 = fires2019 .select('FireMask') .map(function(img) { return img.gt(0).rename('fire_count'); }) .reduce(ee.Reducer.sum()); // 5. Get fire counts in Brazil const fireCount2007 = countFires2007.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: brazil, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('fire_count_sum').getInfo(); const fireCount2019 = countFires2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: brazil, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('fire_count_sum').getInfo(); print('Fire Detection Results:'); print('2007 Fire Detections: ' + fireCount2007); print('2019 Fire Detections: ' + fireCount2019); // 6. Validation if (fireCount2007 === null || fireCount2019 === null) { print('C3'); return; } if (fireCount2007 === 0 && fireCount2019 === 0) { print('C2'); return; } // 7. Compare: Were there fewer detections in 2019 than 2007? if (fireCount2019 < fireCount2007) { print('A'); } else { print('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
